test_transformer_wav2vec2: run the transformer wav2vec2 speech recognition test on LibriSpeech with a reference WER score of 38
test_conformer_wav2vec2: run the conformer wav2vec2 speech recognition test on LibriSpeech with a reference WER score of 4.5
build_generator_w2l_viterbi: build a W2lViterbiDecoder generator for wav2vec2 speech recognition inference using flashlight
postprocess_tokens_letter: postprocess target and hypothesis token sequences into letter strings using the fairseq dictionary
setup_librispeech_test_data: set up LibriSpeech wav2vec2 test data including LTR dictionaries and TSV files for speech recognition tests
